svg.title: Titanic passengers grouped by Sex → Pclass
svg.desc: 891 passengers, 342 survivors. Rectangles show group counts and survival rates. The largest group is male, Class 3: 347 passengers, 47 survivors. Female, Class 1 has 94 passengers, 91 survivors.

svg.text: Data: hogwild / titanic.csv · supplied 891-record sample, not the full ship population.
